items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I remember now, Tio. ... He used a very heavy read. Tio used about a number three read.

ctx.x: Well who had the growling style of clarinet then, you know, with a ratty tone and rough? Ratty and rough. Ratty and rough. Who was rough then in the clarinet players?
Well rough. Rough and carninet players played with, how do they call them, I remember now, Tio.
Tio played a lot of rough stuff.
